title: Transition probabilities summed over intermediate vertices
statement: Let $G$ be a finite regular multigraph of positive degree $D$, and let $k$ be a nonnegative integer and $u,v$ vertices of $G$. The probability that a walk of $k+1$ steps from $u$ ends at $v$ equals the sum over all vertices $x$ of the product of the one-step transition probability from $u$ to $x$ and the $k$-step transition probability from $x$ to $v$.
hypotheses_covered: $G$ is a regular multigraph of positive degree $D$
